_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 top-level design REQUIREMENTS -- what the aircraft must DO, fidelity-independent. SCOPE GUARD: requirements only, never spec data (reference areas, AR, taper, sweep, t/c, fuselage envelope, thrust, engine model stay in examples/F16A/f16a_L{1,2,3}.json). The .constraints and .missions blocks below follow the same guard: no discipline-owned quantity (CLmax, CD0, K1, K2, CDx, thrust lapse, TSFC come from the injected aero/prop objects) and no spec data (aircraft_category from the injected aero object, n_engines from the injected geometry object). Consumers: design_mach -> F16WeightsL2/L3 + F16GeomL1; cruise.* -> F16WeightsL3. Schema + full per-field citations: examples/F16A/mds/f16a_requirements.md.

constraints._comment: The 8 F-16A constraint conditions. Each object holds REQUIREMENT / CONDITION data ONLY -- the flight condition and the field-performance requirement. NO discipline-owned quantity is present: CLmax/CD0/K1/K2/CDx come from the injected aero object, thrust-lapse alpha and TSFC from the injected prop object, and takeoff/landing gear+flap drag from aero's get_Delta_CD0_TO()/get_Delta_CD0_L(). See examples/F16A/mds/f16a_requirements.md for the schema + full per-field citations.
constraints._cite: Consts! = VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/Brandt-F16-A.xls 'Consts' tab; Main! = its 'Main' tab; Ps! = its 'Ps' tab; f16a_geometry.json = VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/f16a_geometry.json .constraints block; cell-map = VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/cell-map.md.
constraints._note_beta: beta = W/W_TO at which the condition must be met -- a SPECIFIED REQUIREMENT INPUT (user directive 2026-08-04), NOT a mission-analysis output. Operational (thrust) rows = 0.89966696 [Brandt Consts!B23; f16a_geometry.json .constraints.beta_perf]. Field/stall rows (at TOGW) = 1.0.
constraints._note_power_setting: power_setting is derived from the Brandt AB% column: 0 % -> "mil", 100 % -> "AB". Takeoff always evaluates at full AB and carries no power_setting key; Landing is power-off and carries none.
constraints._note_stall: Stall is intentionally NOT an F-16 diagram constraint: at L2/L3 the aero object's geometry-based clean CLmax (~0.91) puts the stall wall at W/S ~ 62 psf and spuriously binds the optimum. The fix belongs in aerodynamics (clean-CLmax root cause, ToDo_Darshan.md #3); re-add a Stall condition here once that lands. StallConstraint.m still exists and is unit-tested standalone. Stall-speed value for reference: Mach 0.217466 at sea level [Brandt Ps!B10].

missions._comment: Mission PROFILES: the ordered segment sequence each mission flies -- a REQUIREMENT (what the aircraft must DO), fidelity-independent. Each segment block carries the MINIMUM per-segment inputs only: type, end flight condition (alt_ft/mach_end = END-of-segment waypoint; the segment START is the previous segment's end), and whichever of distance_nm / time_min / drop_lb / percent_ab / cd0_increment applies. NO discipline-owned data (CLmax, CD0, K1/K2, thrust, TSFC come from the injected aero/prop objects) and NO spec data (aircraft_category from the injected aero object; n_engines from the injected geometry object).
missions._cite: cap = temp_Casey/inputs/Mission_Profile.xlsx CAP sheet (via the retired examples/F16A/jsons/mission_profile.json); brandt_14seg = VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/f16a_geometry.json .mission (Brandt-F16-A.xls Miss tab).
missions._note_percent_ab: percent_ab: afterburner setting 0-100 (0 = mil/dry, 100 = full AB, 50 = partial). Omitted => 0 (dry). Selects/blends the prop TSFC: cT = cT_dry + (percent_ab/100)*(cT_AB - cT_dry), and the thrust lapse alpha the same way [MissionEquations.select_alpha].
missions._note_cap_climb_ab: CAP Climb uses percent_ab = 100 (added 2026-08-13). The key was absent, thus the climb to 40,000 ft used dry thrust. The F-16 climbs with the afterburner [T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. VI, climb schedule at MAX power]. With dry thrust and a high weight, the specific excess power becomes negative near 40,000 ft. The Brandt profile keeps its own settings, because it replicates Brandt's workbook.
missions._note_cd0_increment: cd0_increment: en-route external-stores parasite-drag increment added to the clean CD0 in the L2 drag-fuel term. Omitted => 0. Deliberately NOT set on takeoff/landing -- their gear+flap drag comes from aero.get_Delta_CD0_TO()/get_Delta_CD0_L() instead, so putting it here too would double-count. Brandt CDx values applied here: 0.010 on Accel..Combat, 0 afterward.

cap._description: Combat Air Patrol -- 10 segments (Casey's CAP sheet). Accel/Egress are genuinely absent vs Brandt's 14; Patrol/Patrol2/Patrol3/Climb2 are 0-duration bookkeeping waypoints CAP omits.

brandt_14seg._description: Brandt F-16A Miss-tab mission -- 14 segments. Patrol/Patrol2/Patrol3 are 0-min waypoints; Climb2 is a same-condition (Delta-h=0) leg that computes ~0 fuel. Validation target: Miss!O9 = 6000.43 lb total burn at W_TO = 31377 lb.
